rows.note: Use 標籤 as the all-purpose word for a physical tag, a social categorisation, or text identifying a control in software.

example.english: The label on the shirt gives the washing instructions.
example.traditional: 件衫個標籤寫住洗水方法。
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 go3 biu1 cim1 se2 zyu6 sai2 seoi2 fong1 faat3

rows.note: Use 唱片公司 specifically when label means the company that releases or sells records.

example.english: This label has made many local singers famous.
example.traditional: 呢間唱片公司捧紅咗好多本地歌手。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 coeng3 pin2 gung1 si1 pung2 hung4 zo2 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 go1 sau2
